title: Bad Bunny’s Closing Out Debí Tirar Más Fotos Tour With Sold-Out Puerto Rico Shows: How to Get Last-Minute Tickets
summary: The Puerto Rican superstar is adding two San Juan shows to end his global tour, returning to where his record-breaking run began.
contentText:

After more than a year of taking the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour around the globe, Bad Bunny is bringing the trek home to Puerto Rico for two final shows .

The Puerto Rican superstar will close out the world tour with back-to-back performances at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan on Saturday (Aug. 22) and Sunday (Aug. 23). The finale, billed as “Cerramos en Casa,” was announced Monday (Aug. 17), following weeks of speculation that Bad Bunny would add one more stop to the tour in his native Puerto Rico.

The shows sold out shortly after tickets went on sale Wednesday (Aug. 19), with more than one million fans reportedly joining the virtual queue in an effort to secure tickets.

Buy: Bad Bunny Tickets At Ticketmaster

The Puerto Rico finale brings the tour full circle for Bad Bunny. Before embarking on his global tour, the artist launched the Debí Tirar Más Fotos era with his historic “No Me Quiero Ir de Aquí” residency at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico, known as El Choli.

From there, he took the album’s world tour across five continents, bringing the show’s signature “La Casita” set to fans around the globe. Along the way, he carried a piece of Puerto Rico with him, sharing the island’s culture, music and spirit with audiences everywhere.

Now, fans who missed the initial ticket sale can still look to resale and third-party ticketing sites for last-minute seats to the sold-out Puerto Rico shows. Availability and prices can change quickly as the Aug. 22 and 23 performances approach.

How to Get Bad Bunny Finale Tickets Online

Fans looking for last-minute tickets to Bad Bunny’s sold-out Puerto Rico shows can check resale marketplaces including StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork and Gametime . Inventory, seating options and prices vary by platform, so shoppers should compare listings before purchasing.

For another last-minute ticket option, check Gametime, where Bad Bunny tickets were starting at $247 at the time of writing. The marketplace offers a low-price guarantee, event cancellation protection and on-time ticket delivery to help simplify your purchase.

Released in January 2025, Debí Tirar Más Fotos became another career-defining album for Bad Bunny, debuting at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 before reaching No. 1. The project also produced “DTMF,” which returned to the top of the Billboard Hot 100 following his Super Bowl halftime performance .

For those lucky enough to have experienced the artist’s residency in summer 2025, where it all began, the love for Puerto Rico and its culture could be felt in every corner of the venue. The stands shook as thousands danced salsa and perreo, laughed with friends and captured photos they’d hold on to forever, including the singer, who made sure to take one at the end of every performance. It was clear the residency was more than a concert for the people of Puerto Rico — it was a once-in-a-lifetime celebration of home, music and the place that shaped him.

Now, as Bad Bunny prepares to return to the island, fans will get to relive that same sense of community for two final nights.
